report_text: Complainant Bhavna Modi reported that on the evening of 20 August two men in a white SUV, registration SYN-GJ-1004, arrived at her shop near Ahmedabad_Zone_5 and demanded Rs 90,000. She named one of the men as Anil Trivedi and said he had called her from 9000010004 earlier that week.
Witness reported that Vijay Solanki was seen near Surat_Zone_3 at about 9:30 pm on 19 August, the day before the incident.
Investigation notes mention that Kiran Desai met Imran Qureshi near Ahmedabad_Zone_9 on the night of 17 August. A vehicle with registration SYN-GJ-1003 was also noted.
A transaction of Rs 95,000 from the account of Kiran Desai to Anil Trivedi on 19 August was identified during the preliminary investigation.

Deepak Chauhan reported that his car, registration SYN-GJ-1005, was stolen from Vadodara_Zone_4 overnight. Neighbours noticed Farida Sheikh near the parking area.
Burglary reported at a shop in Ahmedabad_Zone_5. The watchman recalled seeing Harsh Vyas driving a van earlier in the evening.
Complainant Pooja Joshi lost Rs 48,000 in an online payment fraud. The funds were traced to an account held by Sanjay Bhatt.
Tarun Sharma filed a complaint against Anjali Kulkarni over a fake invoice for Rs 15,500. Payment was made to her account on 4 August.
Robbery reported on the Ahmedabad_Zone_9 highway. A witness noted the attackers' car, registration SYN-GJ-1002.
